name: Team India Guaranty Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, Times Guaranty Ltd is an NBFC and is engaged in investing activities of its own funds.
keyPoints:
Registration:[1]
Company is registered with SEBI as Category I Merchant Banker and has membership of over the Counter Exchange of India. Also, company has a NBFC registration certification (without accepting public deposits) from Reserve bank of India.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 226 days to 107 days
cons: Stock is trading at 4.87 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 9.35% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.78% over last 3 years.
